The '''Drezzi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drezzi]].
